title: ST4 migration worker result
description: Structured result a single ST4 migration worker must return for exactly one ledger item. The external controller (tools/st4-loop) validates this and never trusts self-reported success alone: it re-runs deterministic gates and a read-only reviewer before committing.

itemId.description: The ledger entry id this worker was assigned. Must echo it verbatim; a worker never selects a different task.

outcome.description: success = slice migrated and locally green; failed = attempted but not green (retriable); blocked = a reproducible obstacle the worker cannot resolve (needs human/other slice).

summary.description: One-paragraph human summary of what changed and why.

filesChanged.description: Repo-relative paths the worker created or modified. The controller commits EXACTLY these (plus the ledger); anything else dirty is treated as accidental and reverted.

statusAdvance.description: If the slice advanced the ledger status, the new status (must be forward along meta.statusOrder). null if no status change.

verificationRun.description: Commands the worker ran locally and their result, e.g. './gradlew :naca-trans:test --tests "*Return*" -> PASS'.

debtDelta.description: Change in debt counts caused by this slice. directBackends must be <= 0 (a slice never adds direct backends).

evidence.description: Test class names / commands / file:line proving the claim.

blocker.description: Reproducible blocker description (required when outcome=blocked, else null).
